Interface Decl<V>

All Known Implementing Classes:
Decl.Inherit, Decl.Set
public sealed interface Decl<V> permits Decl.Set<V>, Decl.Inherit<V>
A behavior declaration at ONE specificity level (per-slot, per-group, …). The tri-state of THE ONE WINDOW's cascade, made structural:
  • Decl.Set — this level declares an explicit value; the walk STOPS here and uses it (including an explicit OFF, e.g. Set(TriBool.FALSE)).
  • Decl.Inherit — this level explicitly defers; the walk falls through to the next-lower level. Behaviorally identical to the absence of any declaration at this level, but nameable on purpose.

FROZEN-CLOSED

Unlike KindTag / Token (frozen-OPEN), the Decl permits set {Set, Inherit} is frozen forever — there is never a third kind of declaration. The resolver may switch on it exhaustively.
